anchoring.adapt: The vanilla fuel-station shop (FuelStation_E_01_building, 10.9 x 5.5 m) is already furnished: a shop counter with its register prop at the -x end (local x -4.7, z -0.65, register at y 1.139), the street door on the +x wall at about z 0.35. The kit adds what the systems read: the attended till (meshless `LF_FuelTill_Attended`, on the register's own spot, so the robbery hold and the fuel_clerk dialogue find it), the fuel clerk behind the counter (local x -4.95, z -1.45, facing +z to the customers: the counter's front, and the register's back, are on its -z side) and the resident anchors (`counter` beside the clerk for the night-shift attendant, `door` on the forecourt by the street door). The slot's marker is the FuelTill place. Rows are rigid: shift, never stretch. The two forecourt pumps (`pump-a`, `pump-b`) are LF_FuelPump (the vanilla tank pistol with the fuel station component, station id saint-philippe): each stands on the exact spot of a vanilla pump under the canopy, 3.5 m off the building front, so the vanilla pump under it is covered and its free refuel is switched off by the pump overlap check. The kiosk sells the pack's `fuel_kiosk` stock (map, water, soda, chocolate, crackers; LF_ShopStock_FuelKiosk.conf) through `kiosk-shop`, a bare shop entity on the counter top; `kiosk-display` is the goods themselves, one model per spot on the building's own wooden shelf unit (ShelfUniversal_01_narrow, local x 0.26 to 1.16, z 0.01 to 0.38, boards at y 1.188 and 1.677): the map, chocolate and crackers lie on the waist board, the soda and water bottles stand on the next (FuelKiosk_Display.et, meshes only: nothing to take, the till sells). The sales lane runs from the street door (+x wall, z 0.35) north of the vanilla clutter along z 0.6 to 1.9 to the counter front; nothing of the kit stands in it. The pumps are LF_FuelPump on the exact origin of each vanilla pump (platform-local -8.105,-0.769 and 2.541,-0.643 of FuelStation_E_01_V1, turned into the building frame), so the vanilla pump and the selling pump are one mesh.
